title: Choose the visual world
question: Choose the system that should govern the full Golf Swing Analyser experience.

options.label: The Motion Contact Sheet
options.lineage: swing-sequence photography, film contact sheets, and coaching annotation
options.thesis: Every analysis is a sequence of observable moments, with one frame promoted for close inspection.
options.viewport: A large selected swing frame anchors the left two-thirds; a numbered frame strip runs beneath it while a narrow evidence register on the right links phases, measurements, and written observations to exact timestamps.
options.risk: The analog references must remain restrained so the product feels current rather than nostalgic.

raised.raise: One evidence field owns each view; supporting data stays quiet until selected.
Type, rules, and state color carry interaction without floating dashboard furniture.
Responsive layouts remove lower-priority columns before they compress the primary evidence.

options.label: The Replay Desk
options.lineage: elite sports broadcast replay, telestration, and match analysis
options.thesis: The golfer operates a compact replay suite where timecode, phases, and drawn evidence explain the swing.
options.viewport: The video fills most of the screen with a slim phase rail, direct overlay controls, and a broadcast-style evidence rundown rather than a grid of metric cards.
options.risk: It is highly legible and sports-native, but it is the most familiar direction and could drift toward existing performance platforms.

options.label: The Swing Map
options.lineage: orienteering maps, fixed legends, and active course overlays
options.thesis: The body and video form fixed terrain while the swing path and marked phases become the active route through it.
options.viewport: The selected video frame becomes a mapped field with hand path, body lines, confidence regions, and numbered phase controls decoded by a compact legend.
options.case: It makes paths, phases, and confidence exceptionally clear, but golfers identify less immediately with navigation notation than with swing-sequence or replay culture.
options.risk: Too much literal map texture would compete with the golfer and weaken video legibility.

options.label: The Signal Catalog
options.lineage: Factory Records catalog sleeves and plotted signals
options.thesis: Each swing is a numbered artifact organized around a single white movement trace on matte black.
options.viewport: A sparse black analysis field lets one swing trace and one numbered video frame dominate.
options.case: Its focus and restraint are excellent, but the catalog code weakens golf recognition and makes ordinary controls harder to discover.
options.kept: One dominant plot or frame, surrounded by deliberate quiet.
options.risk: The coded identity could become opaque and self-conscious.

options.label: The Live Tile Field
options.thesis: Phase and measurement states become edge-to-edge live fields with almost no interface chrome.
options.viewport: Video, current phase, and primary observation occupy adjacent full-height panes.
options.case: The chrome deletion is valuable, but a tile panorama fragments the continuous relationship between video, timeline, and evidence.
options.kept: Controls should feel inherent to the composition, not added as floating chrome.
options.risk: Large tiles consume too much space when the user needs simultaneous evidence.

options.label: The Phase Board
options.lineage: departure boards, persistent changes, and priority columns
options.thesis: Swing phases are live rows whose measurements update in place without losing their identity.
options.viewport: A fixed-column phase ledger sits beside video with changed or low-confidence evidence held visibly in place.
options.case: The state model is excellent, but a ranked board implies schedule monitoring rather than visual movement analysis.
options.kept: Preserve item identity through changes and drop responsive columns by priority.
options.risk: The rigid row grammar under-serves video and charts.

options.label: The Phase Cast
options.thesis: Each phase receives a vivid identity and a fixed place in a finite swing sequence.
options.viewport: A grid of phase portraits makes every swing moment visually unmistakable.
options.case: The states are memorable, but the friendly collectible tone conflicts with serious evidence review.
options.kept: Every phase must remain recognizable without reading its label.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished dark sports dashboard with rounded metric cards, green accents, and a conventional upload hero.
canonCard.viewport: A centered upload card gives way to a familiar video-and-metrics dashboard.
canonCard.risk: Professional and usable, but intentionally difficult to distinguish from competing sports and AI products.
